purpose: Re-pin each SPEC §2 capability claim to current code with reproduction results. Runtime call sites were inspected; a claim proved only by a test or comment is downgraded. Unreproduced external facts are reported_pending_phase0_verification.

state_vocabulary.implemented_wired: Exists AND invoked by a runtime call site (not only tests/comments).

state_vocabulary.test_or_comment_only: Referenced only by tests or comments; production wiring UNVERIFIED.
state_vocabulary.reported_pending_phase0_verification: Requires prohibited external access (Gmail/Vin/live) to confirm; cannot be reproduced in Phase 0.
